As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale.

- Develop tools and processes that drive engineering efficiency at Databricks. We enhance the developer experience for Databricks engineers across various areas, including programming languages, linters, static analysis, IDEs, remote development environments, automated release pipelines, and test automation frameworks.
